about.heading: Structured learning, clear websites and consistent visuals.
about.photoAlt: Mary Oduselu smiling, in a black and white floral top, against a green textured backdrop
paragraphs: I am an instructional designer in Lagos with a background in web design, graphic and video content, and curriculum planning. I design structured learning for children and adults, and I build the websites and visuals that go with it.

Alongside design, I spent ten years in business development, managing B2B clients from proposal to delivery. That is why I plan every project around the audience and the goal, and why I deliver on time. I hold an MBA in Management (Distinction) from Covenant University.

services.heading: Three disciplines, one habit: start with the person who will use it.

items.title: Instructional design
items.description: Training needs assessment, curriculum and lesson planning, storyboarding and instructional writing using the ADDIE framework, including gamified learning for children and adult learners.

items.title: Web design
items.description: Websites built on WordPress for networks, organisations and clients, from the first sketch to launch and handover.

items.title: Graphic design
items.description: Brand identities, event flyers, presentations, short videos and digital products that follow brand colours and guidelines.

process.heading: The same five steps on every project.
process.intro: The same five steps apply whether I am building a course, a website or a brand.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: Learn the goal, the audience and the constraints.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Outline the structure and agree the look before building.

steps.title: Develop
steps.description: Build the full version in small steps you can review.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: Launch, hand over files and show you how to update them.

steps.title: Evaluate
steps.description: Check the result against the goal and improve it.
